name: Cable Seated Twist
steps: Sit sideways on a bench beside a chest-height cable and hold the handle with both hands in front of you.
Turn your rib cage away from the pulley and carry the handle with your chest.
Rotate back toward the pulley under control.
Switch sides and repeat the movement.
tips: Keep both sitting bones against the bench.
Keep your arms long in front of your sternum so your core drives the twist.
